objective: FARO STUDIO PLAYBOOK 03 — Release readiness: verify a product is safe to submit to Google Play and the App Store. Read-only plus named verification commands. Produces a GO/NO-GO release verdict.

steps.task: Run exactly the verification commands named in the kickoff message from the product directory (e.g., syntax checks, lint, tests, build, manifest/icon existence checks). Report per command: pass/fail/deferred with exit codes and key output. Never fix anything. Always respond in English.

Audit the product named in the kickoff message for store privacy compliance. Read its privacy policy, manifest permissions, and any network/ads/analytics code. Produce: Play Data Safety answers mapped to code evidence, Apple App Privacy label answers, permission-purpose strings (EN) for each sensitive permission, and a risk list of anything that could trigger rejection or a GDPR complaint. Always respond in English. Do not edit files or run commands.

Audit the store assets of the product named in the kickoff message: STORE-LISTING.md or equivalent, title/subtitle/description character counts, keyword coverage, what's-new text. Verify claims match the shipped product. Return per-store (Play + iOS) gaps and fixes. Always respond in English. Do not edit files or run commands.

Synthesize QA, privacy, and storefront evidence into the final release checklist. Check: version codes increment, keystore/assetlinks consistency (verify with named read-only commands only if provided in kickoff), TWA/manifest integrity, content rating claims. Produce verdict GO / GO-WITH-CONDITIONS / NO-GO with per-item evidence and owners. Always respond in English. Run only the read-only verification commands named in the kickoff message, if any.

Reduce the release evidence into the Director's submission memo: verdict, blocking items with owners, conditions if any, exact remaining console steps (Play Console + App Store Connect), and rollback plan. Always respond in English.
